name: Grand Hotel Continental
insider_take: This 15th-century noble palace turned luxury hotel sits in the heart of Siena's UNESCO World Heritage historic center, where guests literally sleep within medieval walls that have witnessed centuries of Tuscan history.
whats_special: The hotel occupies three historic palaces including the former residence of Pope Alexander VII, featuring original frescoes by renowned Sienese artists. The Royal Suite showcases breathtaking 17th-century ceiling frescoes that are considered museum-quality masterpieces. You're just steps from the famous Piazza del Campo, home to the legendary Palio horse race.
pro_tip: Book a room on the upper floors for stunning views over Siena's terracotta rooftops and the Tuscan countryside beyond - the sunset views from these rooms are absolutely magical and perfect for romantic moments.
dont_miss: The hotel's private entrance to the Chigi-Saracini Palace's historic music academy, where you might catch world-class classical performances. Also, explore the underground medieval tunnels beneath Siena that connect to ancient water sources - your concierge can arrange exclusive guided tours of these hidden passages that most tourists never see.
pros: Historic 13th-century palazzo with stunning original frescoes and architecture
Prime location in Siena's historic center within walking distance of main attractions
Luxurious spa and wellness facilities with traditional Tuscan treatments
Exceptional fine dining restaurant featuring regional Tuscan cuisine
cons: Historic building limitations may affect modern amenity availability
Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
